decisions.reason: As a garage door operator line it still builds directly on our installed base, service network and product knowledge, but the lack of later visibility suggests some risk of integration into a broader operator range rather than full continuation as a separate line.

The solid wood sectional garage door remains the weakest fit with our mainly metal-based manufacturing and learning base, so with limited visible follow-through we would reallocate resources to product families where our absorptive capacity is stronger.

A garage door operator with remote control is technologically close to our capabilities, but because remote control is likely to be absorbed into standard operator offerings, the stand-alone product faces high consolidation risk.

The glazed industrial sectional door is closely related to our industrial door architecture, compliance expertise and customer relationships, so we can still learn from and improve it even if portfolio simplification remains possible.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door fits especially well with our strengths in thermal performance, industrial applications and regulated building solutions, giving it the strongest basis for continued development.

Although this glazed industrial sectional door is close to our core knowledge base, its strong similarity to adjacent glazed industrial variants makes it a likely candidate for rationalization into a narrower, easier-to-develop portfolio.
